sql: SELECT TOP 25 p.SKU AS sku, p.ProductName AS name, p.PimProductId AS productId, cat.PimCategoryHierarchyId AS categoryId, mq.val AS maxQuantity, mn.val AS minQuantity, MAX(gp.RetailPrice) AS retailPrice, MAX(gp.SalesPrice) AS salesPrice, MAX(br.brandName) AS brandName, MAX(br.brandCode) AS brandCode, MAX(tb.sd) AS shortDescription, MAX(tb.ld) AS details, MAX(tb.sp) AS specifications, MAX(tb.sh) AS shippingInfo FROM dbo.ZnodePimProduct p INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishState ps ON ps.PublishStateId = p.PublishStateId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeInventory i ON i.SKU = p.SKU INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalWarehouse pw ON pw.WarehouseId = i.WarehouseId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortal po ON po.PortalId = pw.PortalId CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 pr.RetailPrice, pr.SalesPrice FROM dbo.ZnodePrice pr INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceList pl ON pl.PriceListId = pr.PriceListId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePriceListPortal plo ON plo.PriceListId = pl.PriceListId WHERE pr.SKU = p.SKU AND plo.PortalId = po.PortalId AND (pl.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pl.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pl.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pl.ExpirationDate >= @now) AND (pr.ActivationDate IS NULL OR pr.ActivationDate <= @now) AND (pr.ExpirationDate IS NULL OR pr.ExpirationDate >= @now) ORDER BY plo.Precedence, pl.PriceListId, pr.PriceId) gp CROSS APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 ch.PimCategoryHierarchyId FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct cc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy ch ON ch.PimCategoryId = cc.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCatalog pbc ON pbc.PimCatalogId = ch.PimCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pcc ON pcc.PublishCatalogId = pbc.PublishCatalogId WHERE cc.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND pcc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND cc.Status = @isActive ORDER BY ch.PimCategoryHierarchyId) cat OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 mav.AttributeValue AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue mpv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute mpa ON mpa.PimAttributeId = mpv.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale mav ON mav.PimAttributeValueId = mpv.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale mlo ON mlo.LocaleId = mav.LocaleId WHERE mpv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND mpa.AttributeCode = @maxQuantityCode AND mlo.IsDefault = @defaultLocale ORDER BY mpv.PimAttributeValueId, mav.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocaleId) mq OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 nav.AttributeValue AS val FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue npv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute npa ON npa.PimAttributeId = npv.PimAttributeId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale nav ON nav.PimAttributeValueId = npv.PimAttributeValueId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeLocale nlo ON nlo.LocaleId = nav.LocaleId WHERE npv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND npa.AttributeCode = @minQuantityCode AND nlo.IsDefault = @defaultLocale ORDER BY npv.PimAttributeValueId, nav.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocaleId) mn OUTER APPLY (SELECT TOP 1 bl.BrandName AS brandName, bd.BrandCode AS brandCode FROM dbo.ZnodeBrandDetails bd INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodeBrandDetailLocale bl ON bl.BrandId = bd.BrandId WHERE bd.BrandCode = p.Brand AND bl.LocaleId = @localeId ORDER BY bd.BrandId, bl.BrandDetailLocaleId) br OUTER APPLY (SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @shortDescriptionCode THEN tx.v END) AS sd, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @detailsCode THEN tx.v END) AS ld, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @specificationsCode THEN tx.v END) AS sp, MAX(CASE WHEN tx.c = @shippingInfoCode THEN tx.v END) AS sh FROM (SELECT ta.AttributeCode AS c, COALESCE(tt.AttributeValue, tl.AttributeValue) AS v FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue tv INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute ta ON ta.PimAttributeId = tv.PimAttributeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProductAttributeTextAreaValue tt ON tt.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tt.LocaleId = @localeId LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValueLocale tl ON tl.PimAttributeValueId = tv.PimAttributeValueId AND tl.LocaleId = @localeId WHERE tv.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ta.AttributeCode IN (@shortDescriptionCode, @detailsCode, @specificationsCode, @shippingInfoCode)) tx) tb WHERE p.ProductType = @productType AND p.IsActive = @isActive AND ps.PublishStateCode = @publishState AND po.StoreCode = @store AND gp.RetailPrice > @minPrice AND EXISTS (SELECT pe.PublishProductEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePublishProductEntity pe INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishVersionEntity ve ON ve.VersionId = pe.VersionId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog pc ON pc.PublishCatalogId = pe.ZnodeCatalogId WHERE pe.ZnodeProductId = p.PimProductId AND pc.PortalId = po.PortalId AND ve.RevisionType = @publishState AND ve.IsPublishSuccess = @isActive AND pe.IsActive = @isActive AND pe.IsObsolete = @notObsolete AND pe.ProductIndex >= @minProductIndex) AND CHARINDEX(@space, p.SKU) = @zero AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT rq.PimAddOnProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimAddOnProduct rq WHERE rq.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND rq.RequiredType = @requiredType) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT cl.PimProductTypeAssociationId FROM dbo.ZnodePimProductTypeAssociation cl INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimProduct cp ON cp.PimProductId = cl.PimParentProductId WHERE cl.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND cp.ProductType = @configurableType) AND (@maxPrice IS NULL OR gp.RetailPrice < @maxPrice) AND (@outOfStockOption IS NULL OR p.OutOfStockOptions = @outOfStockOption) AND (@inCategoryId IS NULL OR EXISTS (SELECT ic.PimCategoryProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct ic INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy ih ON ih.PimCategoryId = ic.PimCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCatalog ipc ON ipc.PimCatalogId = ih.PimCatalogId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePortalCatalog ipo ON ipo.PublishCatalogId = ipc.PublishCatalogId WHERE ic.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND ih.PimCategoryHierarchyId = @inCategoryId AND ic.Status = @isActive AND ipo.PortalId = po.PortalId)) AND (@notInCategoryId IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT x.PimCategoryProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct x INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy xh ON xh.PimCategoryId = x.PimCategoryId WHERE x.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND xh.PimCategoryHierarchyId = @notInCategoryId)) AND (@minMaxQuantity IS NULL OR TRY_CAST(mq.val AS FLOAT) >= @minMaxQuantity) AND (@notDiscountedForProfile IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT dp.PromotionId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotion dp WHERE (dp.PortalId IS NULL OR dp.PortalId = po.PortalId) AND (dp.IsCouponRequired IS NULL OR dp.IsCouponRequired = @couponNotRequired) AND (dp.StartDate IS NULL OR dp.StartDate <= @now) AND (dp.EndDate IS NULL OR dp.EndDate >= @now) AND (NOT EXISTS (SELECT dn.PromotionProfileMapperId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProfileMapper dn WHERE dn.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId) OR EXISTS (SELECT dm.PromotionProfileMapperId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProfileMapper dm LEFT JOIN dbo.ZnodeProfile df ON df.ProfileId = dm.ProfileId WHERE dm.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND (dm.ProfileId IS NULL OR df.ProfileName = @notDiscountedForProfile))) AND (EXISTS (SELECT dpp.PromotionProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionProduct dpp WHERE dpp.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND dpp.PublishProductId = p.PimProductId) OR EXISTS (SELECT dce.PublishCategoryEntityId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionCategory dpc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePublishCategoryEntity dce ON dce.ZnodeCategoryId = dpc.PublishCategoryId WHERE dpc.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND CHARINDEX(CONCAT(@comma, p.PimProductId, @comma), REPLACE(REPLACE(REPLACE(dce.ProductIds, @openBracket, @comma), @closeBracket, @comma), @space, @comma)) > @zero) OR EXISTS (SELECT dcp.PimCategoryProductId FROM dbo.ZnodePromotionCategory dhc INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryHierarchy dch ON dch.PimCategoryHierarchyId = dhc.PublishCategoryId INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimCategoryProduct dcp ON dcp.PimCategoryId = dch.PimCategoryId WHERE dhc.PromotionId = dp.PromotionId AND dcp.PimProductId = p.PimProductId)))) AND (@maxPersonalizableAttributes IS NULL OR (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT zpa.PimAttributeId) FROM dbo.ZnodePimAttributeValue zav INNER JOIN dbo.ZnodePimAttribute zpa ON zpa.PimAttributeId = zav.PimAttributeId WHERE zav.PimProductId = p.PimProductId AND zpa.IsPersonalizable = @personalizable) <= @maxPersonalizableAttributes) AND (@preferred IS NULL OR p.SKU = @preferred) GROUP BY p.SKU, p.ProductName, p.PimProductId, cat.PimCategoryHierarchyId, mq.val, mn.val HAVING SUM(i.Quantity) >= @quantityUsed AND (@withBrand IS NULL OR MAX(br.brandName) IS NOT NULL) AND (@withShippingInfo IS NULL OR MAX(tb.sh) IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.SKU
